sentences.text: The sanction letter’s 2% pre-payment charge on the amount prepaid is not compliant with the current rule set for this Tier 3 UCB business loan case, because the applicable current direction says pre-payment charges are not applicable here. (R3, R5, E4)
The bank’s older pre-payment charge directions are no longer in force on 2026-11-23, so they do not govern this case. (R1, R2)
The bank’s own documents do show a 2% pre-payment charge in the sanction letters, but that wording conflicts with the current RBI rule for this case. (E4, E5, R5)
